title: Detailed hot air balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox="0 0 100 100" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Sky glow around balloon -->
  <circle cx="50" cy="38" r="33" fill="#1a1a40" opacity="0.5"/>
  
  <!-- Balloon envelope - main body -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="35" rx="28" ry="30" fill="#ff4444"/>
  
  <!-- Balloon gores (vertical panels) with different colors -->
  <path d="M50 5 Q38 5 30 20 Q25 30 28 50 Q30 60 50 65 Q35 58 32 45 Q30 30 38 15 Q44 8 50 5Z" fill="#ff6666"/>
  <path d="M50 5 Q62 5 70 20 Q75 30 72 50 Q70 60 50 65 Q65 58 68 45 Q70 30 62 15 Q56 8 50 5Z" fill="#ffaa00"/>
  
  <!-- Center gore -->
  <path d="M46 5 Q50 4 54 5 Q56 20 55 40 Q54 55 50 65 Q46 55 45 40 Q44 20 46 5Z" fill="#ffee55"/>
  
  <!-- Additional gores for detail -->
  <path d="M36 8 Q40 20 42 40 Q43 55 44 62 Q40 55 38 42 Q36 25 36 8Z" fill="#ff8844" opacity="0.7"/>
  <path d="M64 8 Q60 20 58 40 Q57 55 56 62 Q60 55 62 42 Q64 25 64 8Z" fill="#ffcc00" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- Balloon top highlight -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="12" rx="10" ry="8" fill="#ffdddd" opacity="0.4"/>
  
  <!-- Horizontal band/decoration -->
  <path d="M25 40 Q50 48 75 40 Q72 44 50 50 Q28 44 25 40Z" fill="#ffdd00"/>
  <path d="M27 44 Q50 51 73 44" stroke="#ff8800" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  
  <!-- Second decorative band -->
  <path d="M30 25 Q50 32 70 25" stroke="#ffcc00" stroke-width="2" fill="none" opacity="0.7"/>
  
  <!-- Zigzag decoration near bottom of balloon -->
  <path d="M33 52 L37 48 L41 52 L45 48 L49 52 L53 48 L57 52 L61 48 L65 52 L69 48" stroke="#ffdd44" stroke-width="1.5" fill="none"/>
  
  <!-- Balloon bottom opening -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="63" rx="14" ry="4" fill="#cc2222"/>
  
  <!-- Suspension ropes -->
  <line x1="38" y1="65" x2="42" y2="78" stroke="#aa7722" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="62" y1="65" x2="58" y2="78" stroke="#aa7722" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="44" y1="66" x2="45" y2="78" stroke="#aa7722" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="56" y1="66" x2="55" y2="78" stroke="#aa7722" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="67" x2="50" y2="78" stroke="#aa7722" stroke-width="1.5"/>
  
  <!-- Basket -->
  <rect x="40" y="78" width="20" height="12" rx="2" fill="#cc8833"/>
  <rect x="40" y="78" width="20" height="3" rx="1" fill="#dd9944"/>
  <rect x="40" y="87" width="20" height="3" rx="1" fill="#aa6622"/>
  
  <!-- Basket weave lines -->
  <line x1="46" y1="81" x2="46" y2="90" stroke="#aa6622" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="50" y1="81" x2="50" y2="90" stroke="#aa6622" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="54" y1="81" x2="54" y2="90" stroke="#aa6622" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="84" x2="60" y2="84" stroke="#aa6622" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  <line x1="40" y1="87" x2="60" y2="87" stroke="#aa6622" stroke-width="0.8"/>
  
  <!-- Small flame/burner glow above basket -->
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="76" rx="4" ry="3" fill="#ffaa22" opacity="0.6"/>
  <ellipse cx="50" cy="76" rx="2" ry="1.5" fill="#ffee88" opacity="0.8"/>
  
  <!-- Small clouds for atmosphere -->
  <ellipse cx="16" cy="30" rx="7" ry="3" fill="#2a2a5a" opacity="0.6"/>
  <ellipse cx="84" cy="52" rx="6" ry="2.5" fill="#2a2a5a" opacity="0.6"/>
  <ellipse cx="80" cy="22" rx="5" ry="2" fill="#2a2a5a" opacity="0.5"/>
</svg>
